findings.evidence: Mathlib/RingTheory/SimpleModule/Basic.lean:70 supplies `IsSimpleModule R R` under `[DivisionRing R]`, and ModuleCat/Simple.lean:34 supplies `simple_of_isSimpleModule`. Dimension/Free.lean:334 defines `Module.finBasis` for finite free modules over a semiring with strong rank condition; FGModuleCat/Abelian.lean requires only `[Ring k] [IsNoetherianRing k]`.
findings.fix: Generalize the instance to `(K : Type u) [DivisionRing K]`; obtain simplicity of `ModuleCat.of K K` through `simple_of_isSimpleModule` instead of `simple_of_finrank_eq_one`.
findings.issue: The `[Field K]` assumption on `instIsFiniteSemisimpleCategoryFGModuleCat` excludes finite-dimensional modules over noncommutative division rings, although the decomposition needs no commutativity.

summary: The module-category instance unnecessarily requires a commutative field; its natural scope is division rings.
